summary: VantageLife 2.0 — Full E2E backend + mobile UI testing. 22/22 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend login, RBAC tab gating, dashboard layout, pulse stepper, manager command panel, and vault flows all rendered and functioned correctly on mobile viewport (375x667). Seeded data (174 agents) loaded automatically on first startup.

issues: Total Team ALP value can overflow the card (e.g. '$560,...') — truncation on narrow 375px viewport. Consider smaller font or adaptiveNumericText.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.
Warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.
useNativeDriver not supported on web — falling back to JS animation (benign on web, but can remove on web platform).

action_items: (LOW) Add testID props on More-menu rows and Manager/Vault inputs to improve automated testability: nav-manager, nav-audit, nav-vault, manager-agent-<id>, manager-new-alp, manager-reason, manager-submit, vault-week-<ws>, vault-compare.
(LOW) Fix deprecated style.resizeMode and props.pointerEvents warnings (non-blocking).
(LOW) On Dashboard, adaptive font size or numeric abbreviation for Total Team ALP to avoid truncation at $560k+ on 375px devices.
(INFO) @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 is newer than Expo-expected 2.2.0 — functioning but may produce warnings on native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1076 lines — consider splitting auth, dashboard, pulse, manager, vault modules for maintainability (>700 line rule).
gate_state() has dead branch: `h == 6 and dt_local.minute < 1` returns 'open' which is already the default.
submit_pulse has a vestigial conditional block (lines 477-479) that does nothing; safe to remove.
Seed endpoint POST /api/seed is unauthenticated — anyone could call /api/seed with {"force": true} to wipe/reseed data. Gate behind level_4 or remove from prod.
aggregate_alp uses dict as fallback when docs empty — good. Ensure production_entries index on (sales_day, agent_id) for scale.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all spec flows render correctly; missing nav/form testIDs on secondary screens

seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on backend startup: 174 agents (1 RGA, 4 MGAs, 8 GAs, 161 agents) across MCM/AMP/Dearborn/Heritage/Siren; production entries for last 7 days with recent activity < 60 min for ticker; 8 historical_vault weeks. No additional manual seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo login: POST /api/auth/demo-login {level: level_1..level_4} → returns session_token. Use Authorization: Bearer <token>. Seed runs once on empty DB. To re-seed: POST /api/seed {"force": true} (currently unauthenticated). Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_vantagelife.py. BASE URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. All 22 backend tests + spec'd frontend flows passed. Known /api/seed is publicly callable — should be gated before production.
